There are things you don't learn in any course.
Things that take years to figure out alone.

That moment,
when you're standing in front of a client,
doing exactly what you were taught…

But inside, something doesn't feel right.

And you ask yourself,

How is it that I studied,
and I still don't really get it?

Then the doubt creeps in.
Maybe I'm not good enough…
Maybe this just isn't for me…

But the truth?

It's not you.

You were given technique,
without understanding.

I know that place. Way too intimately.

I went to countless trainings,
tried every method,
spent serious money,
and every single time, I felt something missing.

I worked, I progressed,
but inside, I still didn't have certainty.

And it frustrated me to my core,
because I knew I was capable of more.

Only when I stopped,
and started breaking it all down to the deepest level,
skin, undertone, healing, depth, pigments,

everything started clicking.

And suddenly it wasn't a guess anymore.
It was clear.

My hand stopped trying,
it knew.

And from that place,
I felt the calling.

To pave a path for the artists who truly want to make it.
Without the burns along the way.
Without the doubt and the second-guessing.

So I founded LIN.

A complete system that brings together in one place:

A smart app,
for precise analysis of tone, undertone, and pigment matching.

Digital courses,
that teach you to UNDERSTAND, not just execute.

Professional resources,
charts, work maps, and clear daily-use guides.

And a deep knowledge foundation,
that connects every piece together.

Because here's the truth no one says out loud:

Technique can be drilled, refined, acquired.
But knowledge is what separates average from masterful.

LIN was built to close that gap, once and for all.

No matter where you are today,
this is what will catapult you to PRO.

LIN,
is not about learning more,
it's about UNDERSTANDING more.

22 years ago,
I looked at the booklet from my permanent makeup course
and asked myself:

"How am I supposed to learn this, I don't understand a thing."

There was no professional internet.
There were no digital courses.
There was no one to tell me that undertone
is not in the eyes, it's in the melanin.
I was completely at the mercy of one teacher.

So I learned on my own.
22 years.
Thousands of clients.

Every mistake that cost me dearly
became an insight.
Every insight, a protocol.
Every protocol, a code.

Until one day I understood something simple:

All of this knowledge
is locked inside my head.

And it's simply going to waste in there!
Because this is gold I have to pass on,
and help as many artists as I possibly can...

So I started teaching the code in person.
I saw how easily my students understood what had taken me years to understand.
I saw their successes, and the professional confidence they built with my help.
I felt the satisfaction. I got addicted to it.

And then I decided to translate it.
From the clinic, to the screen.
So that no one would depend on my schedule, and everything would be available to her in her own time.

That's the point:

What took me 22 years to know,
you'll get at the click of a button. 🧬

✨ A 90 minute digital course that sharpens you all the way through.
✨ And very soon: the first app in the world for permanent makeup, synced with the knowledge of the course, completing the picture for you so no excuses are left and you become a master.

Link to the course, and to early registration for the app, in bio ✨

I really am a woman who tries to see the world through pink glasses. Every single day. It's just that sometimes the lens gets a little dirty.
And I'll tell you something, I love those glasses.

Our profession needs that. Enthusiasm. Joy. Love for the pigment, for the skin, for the client.
Without it there's nothing.

The problem starts when the pink glasses are all there is.
When you work only from the hope that "it'll be fine."
That if the execution is steady, if the pigment is good, and if the client agreed to the shade, everything will somehow work out.

And then the healing arrives. And the surprises.

I don't want to take your glasses off.
I want to clean your lenses..
Knowledge. Method. Certainty. C l a r i t y.

That's how the pink stops being only hope,
and starts being proof that you really do know what you're doing.

That's real confidence.
It doesn't come from experience. It comes from understanding.

That's exactly what I give in "The Professional Diagnosis Code"

There are periods in life when from the outside you look completely "normal"...
but inside you're going through a revolution nobody really sees...

These past months I've been working almost without stopping.
Not only on my digital course.
Not only on the app I'm developing.
But on a whole professional framework that I've felt was missing for me in this field for years.

But behind everything you see here there are also a lot of moments of doubt.
Tests that didn't work.
An idea that looked brilliant in my head, but in reality still wasn't precise enough and needed endless corrections.
Nights without sleep.
Fear of releasing something that doesn't truly meet my standards.
And so many moments where I asked myself whether it would simply have been easier to give up...

Because the truth?
It's so much easier to stay in the familiar place.
To keep working the usual way.
Not to take a risk.
Not to be exposed.
Not to build something new from scratch.

But after more than two decades in this field,
I can no longer do only the things that run on autopilot.
I want to create something that will truly help women in my field feel less lost, less unsure, and more confident in themselves..

And maybe that's exactly why it matters to me to share the human side of building all of this too.
Not only beautiful results and perfect photos, but the road as well.
Because everything big starts from uncertainty, from trial and error, and from a decision not to stop even when not everything is clear.

So if you're still here, and following this journey, thank you 🙏🏻
This is probably only the beginning 🦾♥️♥️

I really did cry today....

I scanned a client with my app, and in 15 seconds it produced the exact pigment blend I would have chosen myself after 22 years in this profession.

Exactly.
Nothing left to chance.
Without "let's try it and see if it works."

The LIN app works....🥹🥹🥹

And I'm sitting in front of the screen crying, because I realized I actually did it.

⠀

Many years ago I was in the darkest place a permanent makeup professional can be in. I worked hard, I invested everything, and still I looked at the results with disappointment and knew I could have done better. And it shattered my confidence.

I almost quit.

And then I stopped estimating. I learned the fundamentals all the way through, color theory, the chemistry of pigments, undertone analysis.

⠀

Most of the mistakes in our industry are not technique mistakes. They are diagnosis mistakes.

⠀

You can be the most skilled artist with 10,000 hours of treatments behind you, and if you didn't read the undertone correctly, the result will go wrong. The client will leave disappointed. You'll blame yourself.

And it isn't your fault! Nobody teaches us dermatological cosmetics. And the human eye has a physical limit when it comes to identifying delicate differences in undertone. That's biology.

And one day I received a moment of clarity. I'm a spiritual and believing person, and I knew it wasn't my idea. It was planted in me. I understood that this is my role, to straighten the crooked line in this industry.

That's how LIN was born.

The first app in the world for permanent makeup that:
🔹 Analyzes skin undertone with surgical precision
🔹 Recommends a precise pigment blend, which manufacturer, which color, what percentages, and why exactly this mix

22 years of professional knowledge inside one app. An algorithm that thinks like me, only faster.

The LIN app doesn't come in place of your knowledge, it strengthens it. Just as an MRI doesn't turn a person into a doctor, it turns a doctor into a diagnostician who is ten times sharper.

The link is in bio. You owe this to yourself!

If I survived that and built this out of it, you can do anything!!!

Clients don't pay you for the pigment.
Not for the needle.
And not for the technique.

They pay for your judgment.

For the ability to look at skin and identify things others miss.

To know which shade will still be there a year from now.
To know when neutralizing is needed.
To know when to change technique.
And to know when to tell a client:
"I don't recommend performing this treatment."

Because at the end of the day...

Every professional can learn to perform a technique.

But not every professional knows how to make a decision.

And that is exactly the difference between "regular" permanent makeup and artistry.

If you feel you're ready to take your professionalism up a level and turn yourself into a top professional, I'm here for you! Waiting for you in bio 😘😘

If someone had told me a year ago that this was going to be the most challenging period of my career... I probably wouldn't have believed them.

From the outside it may not always have looked that way.

But behind the scenes there was a year of endless decisions, countless hours of work, trial and error, testing, corrections, nights of thinking, and an enormous amount of responsibility.

Because when you build a system that is meant to help other professionals make more precise decisions... there are no shortcuts.

I could have rushed.
I could have compromised.
I could have said "this is good enough."

But every single time I asked myself one question:

"If I could go back in time, to the very beginning of my own path... would this tool have given me confidence and saved me precious time of confusion and mistakes?"

If the answer wasn't an absolute "yes"...
I went back to work.

This year reminded me of something important.

Even after 23 years in this profession, you can still be a student.

And this past year I really did switch chairs.

After years in which I taught others, I found myself learning from scratch a world I didn't know.

Development.
Product definition.
User experience.
Artificial intelligence.
Strategy.
Marketing.
App stores.
Testing processes.
Project management.

And above all...
Patience.

I invested thousands of hours.
I invested amounts I never imagined I would invest.
And above all, I invested my whole heart.

Not in order to release another product.

But in order to build something I truly believe can make a real change in a profession I love so much.

And the truth?

This year sharpened something important for me.

It doesn't matter how much experience you've gathered.
It doesn't matter how many years you've been in the profession.

The moment you stop being a student... you stop growing...

Because at the end of the day...

The knowledge I've gathered over the years is what made me who I am today.

And the courage to keep learning this year too...
is what wrote the next chapter of my journey ♥️
